name: carousel
useFor: Use Carousel for a short set of peer items people browse one at a time (automation templates, plan highlights). Put each slide in CarouselItem (basis-1/2 for two at once), add CarouselPrevious and CarouselNext, and CarouselDots under the row when the count matters. Leave 48px of room at the sides for the keys.
constraints: Round arrow keys or round dots
Hiding content that people must see in a carousel
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its outlined icon keys (.button--line) and hexagon bullets on a native snapping scroll
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides that snap into place, with 32px outlined hexagon keys for previous and next outside the row and optional point-up hexagon marks for the slides, the current one ink. Native scroll, touch and arrow keys. Slides fade at the edge the track scrolls past (fade-x, or fade-y when vertical).
